templates.name: Top-Down Maze
templates.description: Navigate through a maze using arrow keys. Great for learning map navigation.

files.scripts/player-movement.pxs:
-- Player movement script
local speed = 2

function onUpdate(dt)
  local dx, dy = 0, 0
  
  if input.isDown('left') then dx = -speed end
  if input.isDown('right') then dx = speed end
  if input.isDown('up') then dy = -speed end
  if input.isDown('down') then dy = speed end
  
  if dx ~= 0 or dy ~= 0 then
    entity.move(dx * dt, dy * dt)
  end
end

templates.name: Pixel Art Challenge
templates.description: Animation-focused template with multiple sprite animations.

files.scripts/animation-demo.pxs:
-- Animation demo script
local currentAnim = 'idle'

function onUpdate(dt)
  if input.isPressed('space') then
    sprite.play('jump')
  elseif input.isDown('z') then
    sprite.play('attack')
  elseif input.isDown('left') or input.isDown('right') then
    sprite.play('walk')
  else
    sprite.play('idle')
  end
end

templates.name: Space Shooter
templates.description: An action-packed shooter with enemies and power-ups.

files.scripts/player-ship.pxs:
-- Player ship controls
local speed = 150
local fireRate = 0.2
local fireTimer = 0

function onUpdate(dt)
  -- Movement
  local dx = 0
  if input.isDown('left') then dx = -speed * dt end
  if input.isDown('right') then dx = speed * dt end
  entity.move(dx, 0)
  
  -- Clamp to screen
  local x = entity.getX()
  if x < 1 then entity.setX(1) end
  if x > 14 then entity.setX(14) end
  
  -- Shooting
  fireTimer = fireTimer - dt
  if input.isDown('space') and fireTimer <= 0 then
    spawn('bullet', entity.getX(), entity.getY() - 1)
    fireTimer = fireRate
  end
end
files.scripts/bullet.pxs:
-- Bullet behavior
local speed = 300

function onUpdate(dt)
  entity.move(0, -speed * dt)
  
  -- Remove when off screen
  if entity.getY() < 0 then
    entity.destroy()
  end
end

function onCollide(other)
  if other.tag == 'enemy' then
    other.damage(1)
    entity.destroy()
  end
end
files.scripts/enemy-spawner.pxs:
-- Enemy wave spawner
local spawnRate = 2
local timer = 0

function onUpdate(dt)
  timer = timer + dt
  if timer >= spawnRate then
    local x = math.random(2, 13)
    spawn('enemy', x, -1)
    timer = 0
  end
end
